messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert fired for runtime_queue_depth > 450 in region=us-east-1, service=runtime-prod
pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident #INC-9001 — page sent to @sre-oncall (escalation policy: runtime-queue)
sam: ack
sam: looking at it now, seeing short spikes of 502/timeout from frontends, queue depth jumping to ~600 for ~30s
tasha: any deploys in the last 10m?
sam: no deploys, autoscaler shows recent scaling activity, HPA flapped 2x in 3m
aleks: i see a brief upstream timeout from model-proxy-3 at 15:22:07 which coincides with the spike, lots of retries in the client logs
sam: spinning up extra replicas and pausing canary traffic: `kubectl scale deployment/runtime-service --replicas=8 -n runtime-us`
cs-bot: Notifying CS: potential customer impact in us-east-1 — low throughput / elevated latency. Affected: "BrightNote", "Formsly"
oncall-next: i'll join for handoff if it doesn't stabilize in 10m
sam: temporarily increasing retry backoff on the redis client (local patch) and disabling canary weighting
tasha: any sign of infra issues (hosts, network)?
aleks: hosts look green, network is fine. root cause looks like a transient model-proxy 503 that amplified due to tight retry config
sam: applied a quick debounce to client retries and re-routed 15% of traffic to fallback model set
pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by sam
incident-bot: auto-resolve probe started — will resolve if metrics return to baseline for 60s
(45s later)
incident-bot: auto-resolve check: metrics recovered, queue_depth back to ~80, 5xxs at baseline
pagerduty-bot: PD: Alert auto-resolved after 1m 32s (no manual escalation)
sam: keeping a 20m watch; rollback not needed, mitigation: scale + retry-debounce + traffic split worked
tasha: please open a short postmortem with timeline and root cause. Suspected: upstream model-proxy transient 503s + aggressive client retries.
aleks: dropping logs and sample traces into the PM doc, will add recommended client circuit-breaker params
cs-bot: CS update sent: customers saw brief degraded responses, no data loss, following up with timeline.
sam: suggest PD rule tweak: add a 60s dedup window or require sustained >2m before paging for queue_depth spikes (to reduce flapping)
oncall-next: agreed, i can own the PD rule PR and add a runbook note for oncall about temporary traffic-splits
tasha: assign follow-ups: sam (client retry debounce), aleks (model-proxy root cause and hardening), oncall-next (PD rule/dedup and runbook), cs-bot (customer comms follow-up)
sam: handing off, i'll be available if it re-fires in the watch window
incident-bot: Thread summary: short-lived queue-depth spike due to transient upstream 503s; mitigated by scaling, retry debounce, and traffic split; PD auto-resolved. Action items assigned in postmortem.
